nodes.label: ADR 0013: Payment Side Effects on payment_intent.succeeded
nodes.rationale: Implement post-payment side effects as a separate service payment-side-effects.service.ts called synchronously from the connect webhook handler. Each side effect is independently try/caught. V1 scope: (1) flip appointments.status pending→confirmed, (2) append appointment_status_history row (actor=system, reason=payment_confirmed), (3) send receipt email via Resend (members→auth.user.email; walk-ins→walk_in_customers.email). A side-effect throw must never reach the webhook ack path.
alternatives_rejected: Inline in webhook handler (couples handler to side-effect, bloats handler)
Queue-driven runner (v1 simplicity; revisit if side effects exceed 5 or latency causes Stripe retries)
